title: Supreme Court denies NFL's appeal to keep Brian Flores' discrimination case against league out of court

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Supreme Court denies NFL's appeal to keep Brian Flores' discrimination case against league out of court
sources.description: The NFL appealed to the Supreme Court to allow the dispute to be settled via league-controlled arbitration. The Supreme Court denied that effort, and the case can now move forward in court.
